name: FUN_INTERCO_TRX_SOURCE_DOCS
description: The table contains source document information to prepare and create intercompany transactions.

columns.name: INTERCO_TRX_SOURCE_DOC_ID
columns.description: Document preparation transaction identifier.

columns.name: INTERCO_TRX_SOURCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Application generated unique transaction number.

columns.name: PROCESSING_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Processing status of the intercompany transaction.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Description for intercompany transaction processing error.

columns.name: APPROVAL_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the intercompany transaction approval is required.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the associated source application.

columns.name: DOC_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the document is for a reversal transaction.

columns.name: DOC_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of source document such as Invoice, Credit Memo, and Debit Memo.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: First source document identifier. In most cases, this is mapped to a document header ID.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: Second source document identifier. In most cases, this is mapped to a document line id.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID3
columns.description: Third source document identifier. In most cases, this is mapped to a document distribution id.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID4
columns.description: Fourth source document identifier.

columns.name: DOC_REFERENCE_ID5
columns.description: Fifth source document identifier.

columns.name: DOC_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document number such as invoice number.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document line number such as invoice line number.

columns.name: DOC_DISTRIBUTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document distribution number such as invoice line distribution number.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_TRX_NUMBER1
columns.description: First additional source document number.

columns.name: DOC_ADDITIONAL_TRX_NUMBER2
columns.description: Second additional source document number.

columns.name: DOC_DATE
columns.description: Document or transaction date such as invoice date.

columns.name: DOC_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the source document.

columns.name: DOC_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount for the source document.

columns.name: DOC_LE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the legal entity of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_BU_ID
columns.description: Identifies the business unit of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_ASSET_BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the asset book of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the ledger of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_SUPPLIER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the supplier of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_SUPPLIER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Identifies the supplier site of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the customer of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifies the customer account of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_CUST_BILL_TO_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Identifies the customer bill to location of the source document.

columns.name: DOC_AMOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction amount type such as item, tax, and freight.

columns.name: DOC_CCID
columns.description: Account code combination of the source document.

columns.name: TRX_PROVIDER_CCID
columns.description: Provider account code combination of the intercompany transaction.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Intercompany agreement identifier associated to the source document.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOC_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for intercompany source document group.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for intercompany source document.

columns.name: TA_REFERENCE
columns.description: Transfer authorization reference number.

columns.name: TA_NUMBER
columns.description: Transfer authorization number generated.

columns.name: TA_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Transfer authorization description.

columns.name: TA_TRX_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date of the transfer authorization.

columns.name: TA_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount of the transfer authorization.

columns.name: TA_AMOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transfer authorization amount type.

columns.name: DOC_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Transfer authorization currency.

columns.name: REVERSED_DOC_REFERENCE_ID1

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
